استألفت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْلَفْتُ (istaʔlaftu) /is.taʔ.laf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# اِسْتَأْلَفْتَ (istaʔlafta) /is.taʔ.laf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# اِسْتَأْلَفْتِ (istaʔlafti) /is.taʔ.laf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْلَفَ (istaʔlafa)
# اِسْتَأْلَفَتْ (istaʔlafat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
